title: A sparse array exactly at the array-cell budget is permitted
rationale: The boundary from below. Three columns of three slots is exactly nine cells and exactly the budget, so the comparison must be > and not >=. An off-by-one here turns a documented ceiling into a ceiling minus one, and nobody would notice until a legitimate document at the published figure started failing.
catchesBugClass: An off-by-one at the boundary, in the direction that refuses work the configuration explicitly permits.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch an off-by-one in the other direction; array-cells-one-over-max is the pair.

predicted.detail: Exactly at the budget, so it is permitted. The bound refuses only what EXCEEDS maxArrayCells.
